correctness.rationale: For 0<|alpha|<infinity, finite r>0, omega !=0, any two distinct sites and finite chain L>=2, pair state is an exact convex integral of two pure-qubit product density matrices; separability follows. Let x=|omega|/r, transverse phase-averaged covariance block det C=x^2/(1+4x^2)>0, so Pauli-correlation T has rank>=2. A classical-quantum two-qubit state has T rank<=1, establishing strictly positive ordinary discord on either site. In sparse r->0 limit first two Fourier moments vanish; two-qubit geometric-discord squared-Hilbert-Schmidt formula for K=uu^T+TT^T gives eigenvalues k=(1-t)^2/4 twice and h=t+t^2 once. Their unique crossing t*=(2sqrt(3)-3)/3 yields exact max (2-sqrt(3))/3 and equatorial-to-longitudinal measurement switch; derivative signs on both branches independently checked. At z=0 finite-rate u and T give positive second eigenvalue and the displayed closed radical formula with low/high-x asymptotics. The result does NOT assert HS discord is monotone or entropic discord has this numerical value.
